name: handIn
description: A learner hands in a new version of a homework (DBU-06; security: authenticated): a file they uploaded privately, a link, or text, with an optional note. Checks it is a shared homework of theirs that is not approved, and that a file is theirs, at most 50 MB, of an allowed kind and really what its name says (from the stored, sniffed type). Never overwrites: each hand-in is the next version. Moves the step to handed in and rings the learner's doorbell.
